messages:
mike: FYI spotted requests where fncall returned no tool and no validation metadata. Console shows fallback but we have zero reject telemetry.
anya: can you dump the proxied response?
mike: anonymized log:
```
{"id":"req-555","model":"redwood-open-3b","output":{"text":"...","tool_call":null},"validation":null
}
```
no `validation` envelope at all.
tom: that's the "silent soft-reject" pattern we've discussed in offsite notes. We intentionally null validation to avoid charging, but it makes diagnostics impossible.
sophie: if validator returns soft_reject we should still attach a lightweight envelope: `{status: \"soft_reject\", code: \"enum_mismatch\", billing_exempt: true}`. That keeps billing behavior but surfaces a reason.
mike: +1. Also need gateway routing change: treat `validation.status==\"soft_reject\"` as its own route outcome (route=soft_reject) so quotas/SLAs aren't misattributed to degen fallbacks.
anya: metrics: add `fncall.validation.soft_reject_total` with labels {region,route,model_variant}. Current `fncall.rejects` is too coarse.
tom: agree. I can add metric emission in proxy and a small audit line: `AUDIT fncall soft_reject req-555 reason=enum_mismatch` so the logging pipeline can index reasons. Regex we can use: `AUDIT fncall soft_reject [a-z0-9-]+ reason=[a-z_]+`.
sophie: console UX: add a collapsed badge in per-route table "soft rejects" with a link to sample ids. Behind feature flag for first rollout. Also add short explainer in support docs.
mike: plan: 1) proxy: always emit minimal validation envelope when soft-reject 2) gateway: route-tag soft_reject 3) metrics + audit logs 4) console feature-flagged UI and docs.
anya: timeline? can we do proxy + metric in 24-48h and UI in the next week?
tom: I'll own proxy + tests. Sophie owns UI/docs. Anya will wire metrics and logging pipeline.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: started staging rollout for proxy change (deploy id s-990) by tom 5:10UTC.
mike: once staging canary looks good we'll flip route behavior in gateway (small risk). Keep console behind flag so we don't spam users.
anya: adding unit+integration tests for router and metric labels. tagging @tom @sophie.
sophie: noted, will prepare UI mock and docs blurb.
mike: thanks all. Follow up here with canary results and any odd telemetry spikes. :thumbsup:
